cells.gaps: No fact outside the law says a centre enters a birth digitally when it is declared: events and how the record is made rest on Laws 2011-003 and 2025-011 (MRT-003, MRT-004, MRT-009, MRT-010), which place nothing, and the one other fact on either is from the excluded essay. The office figure is centres equipped against a planned network of 168, from August 2021, with nothing newer; no governance fact falls inside the 36 months (the newest is 2022-11) and nothing is held for the last twelve months.
cells.note: 153 of 168 citizen reception centres were equipped in 2021 to receive civil status declarations, and a share equipped places at stage 3. Stage 4 needs a share of offices doing the entry and a fact, not a law, saying the entry is made at the office.
